title: crataegus biltmoreana var. stonei
intro: Crataegus biltmoreana var. stonei, commonly known as a hawthorn plant, is a variety of Crataegus biltmoreana that belongs to the Rosaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits, including reducing blood pressure, improving cardiovascular health, and supporting digestive functions. The therapeutic actions of Crataegus biltmoreana var. stonei include acting as a vasodilator, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory agent, which may help in preventing heart disease and other cardiovascular conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, triterpenoids, and oligomeric proanthocyanidins (OPCs), which contribute to its medicinal properties.
